correctness.rationale: Exact Glover step-response superposition yields D_NF-D_FN=Q[G(z)-G(rz)] at 2Δ; direct differentiation proves G has precisely one maximum at sqrt(3 log 2). For each r>1 the difference is negative below z0/r, strictly increasing on (z0/r,z0), and positive above z0, so has exactly one zero and the claimed sign orientation. Implicit differentiation at the root proves strict ratio monotonicity. Endpoint bracketing and positive-zero convergence prove sharp limiting constants. A standalone program verified 5000 parameter instances and 999 monotonicity comparisons; mathematical proof does not depend on finite sampling.

value.rationale: A river-flow management decision with equal total withdrawal and identical pumping resources can be governed by instantaneous end-of-interval depletion rather than total depletion. The theorem supplies a globally valid, computable choice of chronology, an exact unique transition, and sharp universal scaling bounds across arbitrary well-distance ratios, explaining why the intuitive near-well order reverses. It is not a mere numerical table or unmotivated parameter slice. Scope is explicitly restricted to a classical physically motivated linear model.
